% Converted, ltx-talk, C-BACKGROUND workaround NOT applied -- the defect.
%
% ltx-talk has no \usebackgroundtemplate, so the deck stops with "! Undefined control
% sequence". This is the tempting repair: define the command to do nothing, and the error
% goes away. Everything a build normally reports then says the deck is fine.
%
% Measured on ltx-talk 0.6.2 / TeX Live 2026, lualatex, two passes, against after.tex --
% the ONLY difference is the shim block below:
%
%                        pages  Tagged  page-1 ink  page-2 ink  page-3 ink
%   after.tex (workaround)   3     yes      1.0000      1.0000      0.0095
%   this file  (stubbed)     3     yes      0.0025      0.0026      0.0095
%
% Same page count, same tagging, and the text layer still carries every word of the slide.
% The frame is white text on a white page: nothing but the pixels sees it, which is why the
% pixel probe exists (#43).
%
% "ink" is the fraction of non-white pixels over the whole page at 70dpi (frac_nonwhite).
% 0.0025 is the white text's antialiasing against white paper; it is not content.
%
% NB the text layer does differ, by "16×9" and "(Original size: 320×180 bp)" -- but only
% because TeX Live's example-image-16x9 has words printed in it. A photograph would leave the
% two text layers byte-identical, so there is deliberately no assertion on that string.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}
\usepackage{graphicx}

%% --- the stub. after.tex has the shim from assets/preamble-template.tex here.
\newcommand{\usebackgroundtemplate}[1]{}
%% --- end stub

\begin{document}
{
\usebackgroundtemplate{\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth]{example-image-16x9}}%
\begin{frame}[vertical-alignment=bottom]
\frametitle{Warning}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \color{white} White text over the image
  \item<2-> \color{white} Second overlay, still white
\end{itemize}
\end{frame}
}
\begin{frame}
\frametitle{After the group}
The background must not leak onto this page.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
